description: This file defines a React component for visualizing workflow Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). It includes logic for loading DAG data, applying different layouts, rendering with ReactFlow or Deck.GL based on size, integrating external services for data fetching, and providing user controls such as layout adjustment, node selection, and agent filtering. The component manages complex state for nodes, edges, layouts, and rendering optimizations, and includes auxiliary components like sidebars and skeleton loaders.

methods.name: isLightweightDAGResponse
methods.description: Type guard to determine if the provided response is a lightweight DAG response.

methods.name: mapLightweightNode
methods.description: Converts a lightweight node from API response into internal DAG node format.

methods.name: adaptLightweightResponse
methods.description: Transforms a lightweight DAG API response into the internal WorkflowDAGResponse format.

methods.name: applySimpleGridLayout
methods.description: Assigns nodes to a simple grid layout based on their index, depth, and start time.

methods.name: decorateNodesWithViewMode
methods.description: Adds viewMode to nodes for rendering purposes.

methods.name: decorateEdgesWithStatus
methods.description: Annotates edges with status-based styling attributes such as animation and opacity.

methods.name: WorkflowDAGViewerInner
methods.description: Main React component implementing the DAG visualization with data loading, layout management, and rendering logic.

methods.name: WorkflowDAGSkeleton
methods.description: Loading placeholder component shown during data fetch.
